title: Hojuzat — Web & Mobile
summary: OTA travel platform backends powering the Hojuzat website and mobile app — search, booking, and supplier pricing.
description: Hojuzat is an OTA travel & tourism product (website + Android app on Google Play). As a backend engineer on the team, I worked on the server side of search, content ingest, booking-related flows, and third-party supplier integrations that power live availability and pricing for web and mobile clients.
technical:
Designed a modular integration layer (Strategy/Factory + DI) so hotel suppliers and external APIs can be added without rewriting core search/booking logic — including ZentrumHub (multi-supplier hotel API), Expedia lodging inventory/booking, and Vervotech hotel/room mapping & canonical content.

Live availability and pricing ship via Laravel Reverb WebSockets, with short-polling fallback. Large hotel/geography datasets move through CSV streaming pipelines (generators + chunking). Horizon queues and scheduled jobs keep third-party content in sync. Redis caches materialized search data; PostgreSQL GiST indexes power geo queries. Docker and CI/CD support consistent deploys. APIs are consumed by the web product and the Hojuzat mobile app.

title: Jiovaniaff SaaS & commerce
summary: Affiliate SaaS v2 and e-commerce apps (Kayan, Jiovaniaff v1, Egygomla) at Nullisues.
description: At Nullisues International I led backend work for Jiovaniaff SaaS v2 (affiliate) and e-commerce apps including Kayan, Jiovaniaff v1, and Egygomla.
technical: Multi-tenant Laravel (custom HMVC) with Redis caching/queues, Docker, and Laravel Octane. Optimized APIs for React/Flutter with raw SQL over Eloquent; State pattern for order workflows. Real-time features via Ratchet WebSockets on PostgreSQL.
